endorsements.name: Till Krüss
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-24226
endorsements.description: In the AccessAlly WordPress plugin before 3.5.7, the file "resource/frontend/product/product-shortcode.php" responsible for the [accessally_order_form] shortcode is dumping serialize($_SERVER), which contains all environment variables. The leakage occurs on all public facing pages containing the [accessally_order_form] shortcode, no login or administrator role is required.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.
